verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that an API reference section exists (bolna-docs-15) and that there is a step-by-step API quickstart (bolna-docs-14), but nothing documents an interactive explorer, a 'try it' playground, or runnable examples inside the reference. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is also no sign of a spec-driven interactive console. A static reference and quickstart are adjacent material, not the interactive capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
